newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra shares off despite Q3 EPS rise.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra shares off despite Q3 EPS rise.

text.p: ConAgra Inc shares fell 1-3/8 at 55-3/8 despite a rise in third quarter earnings to $0.63 a share from last year's $0.55, due to profit-taking and some concern about earnings from operations, analysts said.
Quarterly earnings met the First Call mean.

"Most of us had expected a higher interest charge," J.P. Morgan analyst Erika Long said. "(Earnings) came in on expectations with lower interest expense," which indicated earnings from operations were not as strong as planned.
ConAgra's third quarter interest expense dropped 11.3 percent to $73.3 million, from $82.6 million a year ago.

Long added she was disappointed by a three percent drop in combined Hunt-Wesson/frozen foods unit volume in the third quarter. The company said that drop was due to sluggish categories and soft grocery industry sales.
Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said earnings generally met expectations or were $0.01 a share better than expected.
"The stock has been running ahead of earnings," Ghez said.
Shares on Thursday opened at 56-1/4, near ConAgra's 52-week high of 57-3/8.
